# test_snake_to_camel.py
import pytest

from your_module import snake_to_camel          # adjust the import to where the function lives


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Happy-path / “normal” behaviour
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "snake, expected",
    [
        ("hello_world", "helloWorld"),          # simple, two parts
        ("alreadycamel", "alreadycamel"),       # no underscore → unchanged
        ("version_2_test", "version2Test"),     # numeric middle part
        ("mixed_Case_input", "mixedCaseInput"), # mixed lower/upper
    ],
)
def test_snake_to_camel_happy_path(snake, expected):
    assert snake_to_camel(snake) == expected


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Edge-case behaviour
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "snake, expected",
    [
        ("", ""),                       # empty string
        ("_", ""),                      # single underscore only
        ("___", ""),                    # only underscores
        ("_private_var", "PrivateVar"), # leading underscore
        ("ends_with_", "endsWith"),     # trailing underscore
        (
            "multiple___underscores",
            "multipleUnderscores",      # consecutive underscores collapse
        ),
    ],
)
def test_snake_to_camel_edge_cases(snake, expected):
    assert snake_to_camel(snake) == expected


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Error handling / wrong-type inputs
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad_input", [None, 123, 12.34, ["not", "a", "str"]])
def test_snake_to_camel_type_errors(bad_input):
    """
    Any non-string argument should raise, because the object does not
    implement .split('_').  Python raises AttributeError in that scenario.
    """
    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
        snake_to_camel(bad_input)
